channel.title: The Genome Brief (ended)
channel.description: This show has ended and its back catalogue has been retired. It has been succeeded by "SARS-CoV-2: A History Run-Through", a chronological walk through the SARS-CoV-2 literature from 2020 to the present, one landmark paper per episode, published Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
